title: SvelteKit: file-based routing, layouts and route groups

videos.script:
Until now the planner has been one page. {{folders}} In SvelteKit a page is a folder, and the file inside it. The planner gets a second one, About, with a plain link between the two.

Then the part of the page that stays. {{layouts}} A layout wraps every page below it, and it is not rebuilt when you move between them. The header goes there.

Then groups. {{groups}} A folder in brackets adds nothing to the address. It gives the planner's pages a layout of their own, and that layout is where the planner lives now.

Then a page for every course. {{params}} One folder in square brackets answers every course id. A matcher then says what an id looks like, and anything else is a four oh four. {{errors}} You will write the page that says so, and check that the status still says so too.

And last, what a click keeps. {{navigation}} Move between two pages of the planner and nothing is lost. Go to About and back, and a session you added is gone. That is the problem the next two lessons solve.
